title: Synthetic municipal inspection issue — training example only
procedural_posture: Fictional draft-policy review; no real person, property, ordinance, or court case is represented.
actors: Municipal inspection official (role and authority not independently verified)
questions: What facts and legal sources are needed to assess a proposed nonconsensual residential inspection process?

documents.title: Fictional draft inspection policy
documents.text: A fictional city proposes periodic interior inspections of private residences. A resident may decline entry, after which the city says it may seek an administrative warrant. The draft policy refers to verifying code compliance but does not identify a schedule, selection criteria, or the proposed warrant's scope.

documents.title: Fictional hearing note
documents.text: One speaker asserted that the inspection process would violate the Constitution. No finding, sworn evidence, or citation is included in this fictional note.

facts.statement: A fictional city proposes periodic interior inspections of private residences.
The draft says a resident may decline entry and the city may then seek an administrative warrant.
The draft refers to verifying code compliance but does not identify a schedule, selection criteria, or warrant scope.
A hearing speaker called the process unconstitutional, but the note includes no citation or adjudicated finding.
